objects.name: totals

variables: The context of the main agent is below 85% of the tokens at which it compacts by itself.
It sums the amount of only the rows with status paid, for each region.
The object `rows` shows fewer than 600 rows.
The object `totals` shows a total for each region with no error.
notes: Feed ends at 600 rows. When rows shows 600, the answer is the head output of totals. If a column gets a new name, rebuild the filter and the aggregate on the new name.
